[00:26:47]W:		 [org.apache.ignite:ignite-core] [2018-07-28 21:26:47,476][ERROR][sys-#97781%partitioned.GridCachePartitionedDataStructuresFailoverSelfTest1%][TcpCommunicationSpi] Failed to send message to remote node [node=TcpDiscoveryNode [id=6c4763cb-2ace-4afe-aa47-870a1dc00003 ...
[00:26:47]W:		 [org.apache.ignite:ignite-core] [2018-07-28 21:26:47,479][ERROR][sys-#97781%partitioned.GridCachePartitionedDataStructuresFailoverSelfTest1%][TcpCommunicationSpi] Failed to send message to remote node [node=TcpDiscoveryNode [id=471ab864-53f1-444f-a29b-dc522be00004 ...

Both nodes are informing via CQ.
Both received event, but failed before event processing.

So, we have 2 node failure events here.
During the first event processing we're closing first CQ (tx) fut inside HighPriorityListener and waiting for second (all) fut inside removeExplicitNodeLocks.
Second fut can't be done before first event processed.

EdShangGG
Could you please review the fix?

P.s. Unfortunately if fixes only only hang - related to failed node processing + CQ notifications.
I see other hangs and going to fix them later.
avinogradov I have left several suggestions on GitHub, please, take a look.

avinogradov
As far as I understand, the main issue here is Discovery thread stucks on removeExplicitNodeLocks and CQProcessor listener has got no node left event.
If it's so, I believe removing locks in async way should resolve this issue.

Please, take a look at IGNITE-9290.

amashenkov,
This may help also, but this will not solve other left/fail event handling issues.
Let's have both cases fixed.

Currently, even in case you're using HighPriorityListener there is no warranty your event will be processed in case of any previous event hang or deadlock.

Why you think this will not help?

AaddNotification method creates a future and put it into a map.
CQ processor has a discovery listener that releases on futures that are alredy in map.

I believe that the only fix you need is justo check if node is gone after future has been put to map but before waiting on it.
Exchange and discovery threads hanging on unlocking should be resolved with IGNITE-9290.

amashenkov,
Current fix is an additional failover for any hangs or delayed processing of failed/left events which can happen and cause deadlock.
As I said, your fix, most likely, solves the problem with tx, but my fix solves any further issues related to event handling issues in advance.
